outcome: Monstrosity N puts N +1/+1 counters on a permanent that is not monstrous and makes it monstrous; a monstrous permanent gets nothing.
A monstrous permanent stays monstrous while on the battlefield and returns from another zone as a new, non-monstrous object that monstrosity can affect again.
note: Partly definitional, but the persistence and reset of the designation is observable through later monstrosity activations and is-monstrous statics.

outcome: Other abilities of the permanent that refer to X use the X value it became monstrous with.
